t.zh: 现在只保留画面的一部分，用<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>完成。先把选中的区域搬进小图，再追踪新图的每一格来自原图哪里；新图左上角不再对应原图左上角。
t.en: Keep only part of the image using <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>. Move the selected region into a smaller image, then track where each new cell comes from. The two top-left corners no longer coincide.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块
desc.en: Takes an image, the top-left corner x0, y0, and a width w and height h; gives the w × h region from (x0, y0)

after.zh: 裁出的数值没有重新估计，变化的是读取位置。沿同一偏移追踪四个角，可以检验<wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref>电路是否保留了整块区域，而不只碰巧取对一格。
after.en: The values were not re-estimated; their read positions changed. Track the same offset at all four corners to check that the <wiki-ref to="crop-vs-resize"></wiki-ref> circuit preserves a whole region rather than one lucky cell.

brief.en: Crop the 2 × 2 region (width 2, height 2) starting at (1, 1).

hint.zh: 新图的 (0, 0) 来自原图的哪一格？
hint.en: Which cell of the original does the new (0, 0) come from?

why.zh: 这是从 (0, 0) 起裁的：新图的 (0, 0) 要取原图的 (1, 1)，每个坐标都加上左上角的偏移。
why.en: That crops from (0, 0): the new (0, 0) must read the original (1, 1); every coordinate adds the corner's offset.

t.zh: 一整张新图的每个<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>都要算出它在原图的坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>：给定宽和高，给出两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>，x 图每格是自己的 x，y 图每格是自己的 y；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>接上坐标图，就一次取出整张图。
t.en: Every <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> of a whole new image needs its coordinates in the original. New part <part-ref to="part:grid"></part-ref>: given a width and a height it gives two coordinate images, each cell of x holding its own x and of y its own y; fed coordinate images, <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> reads a whole image at once. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: 输入一张图和 x0、y0、w、h：交出从 (x0, y0) 起的 w × h 一块。
brief.en: Given an image and x0, y0, w and h, give the w × h region from (x0, y0).

hint.zh: 先给新图每格一对自己的坐标，再挪到原图里去。
hint.en: First give each new cell its own coordinates, then move them into the original.
